**(b) Newsletter opening (104 words)**

We believe that if superintelligent AI is built within the next 20 years, global economic output will at least double within ten years. That is the scale of transformation we are working toward: a new era of discovery, better medicine, and broad-based economic growth. Reaching it will take sustained frontier research, careful engineering, and the ambition to solve problems that once seemed beyond reach. We are committed to protecting the research that makes this progress possible, and to ensuring the United States leads in developing this technology. The choices we make now will shape what superintelligence can deliver for people everywhere—and how quickly its benefits reach the world.
